He sat on the damp rocks and wept, salt meeting salt, while above him the great lens turned patiently, sending its slow pulse of light across the waves she had once crossed.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一只正在翻身的巨兽。路灯还亮着，却已显疲惫，橙黄的光在湿漉漉的柏油路上铺出长长的影。环卫工推着扫帚，沙沙地刮过落叶；豆浆铺的卷帘门哗啦一声升起，蒸汽混着葱花香涌向街心。出租车停在十字路口，司机叼着烟，看红灯一遍遍变绿又变红。远处高楼的窗户零星亮着，像不肯睡去的眼睛。天边泛起一线青灰，鸟还没叫，风却先凉了下来，城市在这短暂的缝隙里，安静地呼吸。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller version of itself.\n- Imagine Russian nesting dolls: you open one and find a smaller one, then a smaller one, until you reach the tiniest doll that doesn't open.\n- In code, a function calls itself on a simpler piece of the problem, and stops when it hits the easiest case it already knows the answer to."}
